content: mkdocs-static-i18n: v1.3.1 tagged 2026-02-20 (1.3.0 Jan 2025), actively maintained; builds a default site version plus one subdirectory per configured language with automatic fallback to the default language; supports suffix- and folder-based docs structures; designed for multi-language sites and documents Material for MkDocs compatibility — unnecessary overhead for a single-language-per-build pipeline.
